items.title: Alex Bigard Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: I played with Kid Rene at the Cadillac nightclub. I played until it closed.

ctx.x: Barney. Barney. We were talking about the band you played with. After Buddy Petit and Sidney Ted Fien. Did you ever play with Kid Rene? You said you did play with Kid Rene. How about how long did you play with?

Well, I played with Rene. I'll let you know. Just a minute. I played with Kid Rene at the Cadillac nightclub. I played until it closed. Is that down at St. Claude? St. Claude, right after the 5th precinct. Papa Kutch used to own it then. Had his brother join church and stopped playing then when you joined Kid Rene? Yeah, his brother joined church. And he had another drummer by the name of Nathan. So I gave up, stopped playing music for a while. I was making so much money in my line of work that I kept so busy…
Well, who did you play with after you played with Sidney Desmond?

items.title: Alex Bigard Interview, 1961-02-07
items.q: my next job, I think, was at the Cadillac with Rene. Rene had a job over there. Oh, yeah. Yeah, that's right. He got the job over at the Cadillac.

ctx.x: That's where you went to play at the Lyric with John. Where did you go after the Brown Derby?

Well, after the Brown Derby, my next job, I think, was at the Cadillac with Rene. Rene had a job over there. Oh, yeah. Yeah, that's right. He got the job over at the Cadillac. Went for Old Man Coochie.
